clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar, young orc and troll hunters are sent to learn from veteran master hunter Ormak Grimshot. After proving themselves with the plains beasts, they travel from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. There they learn to care for, feed, and train a lifelong animal companion.

In Durotar's arid canyon lands, skill with a bow and survival in the harsh wilds are only part of a hunter's duty. Young hunters first tame the plains beasts: fierce boars, crab scavengers, and armored scorpid stalkers. Once they prove their resilience, Thotar sends them from Razor Hill north through the red clay gulches to Orgrimmar's fortified gates, ready to take responsibility for a companion.

Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor is an enclave where veteran stalkers and warriors hone their craft. There, aspiring hunters seek Ormak Grimshot, one of the Horde's revered master hunters. He looks beyond their youth to judge whether they have the patience to command a beast and sustain and nurture it through famine, battle, and loss.

A beast won through force remains wild until hunter and companion come to understand one another. Ormak teaches the sacred traditions that keep their bond: which foods nourish each creature's spirit, how discipline teaches a beast lethal techniques, and the spiritual focus needed to revive one that falls in the line of duty.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.
Travel to Orgrimmar. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, Ormak Grimshot. He will give you the ability to train your new pet. You will find him near the Hall of the Brave.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A young hunter, I see. Yes, I will grant you the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
Now, go, hunter. We will speak again, at a later date.
